basic_info.description: Offers Thursday- Promising investment with this 6-unit apartment building located in the Hayes Valley. The property features six identical one-bedroom units, each boasting a double parlor & the potential to be converted into two-bedroom units. Two units are currently partially remodeled and will be delivered vacant. The third unit is vacating April 2025 with a legally executed buyout agreement. Built in 1900, the building spans 3,450 square feet, complemented by a full basement with an additional 1,150 square feet. This four-story, wood-framed structure sits on a concrete foundation with soft story work complete, showcasing architectural details that highlight its classic SF character. Having remained with the same family for 50 years, the property has accumulated significant deferred maintenance with unit renovation needs and there are 3 long term residents with under market rent. However, it presents potential for a savvy investor willing to invest in updates and improvements. Situated on a side street between Gough & Octavia, this location is highly desirable, offering easy access to numerous bus transit lines, tech shuttle services, and major highways within just a few blocks.
